capabilities: Run a Pomodoro timer with proportional breaks
Browse, create, select, and complete Todoist tasks
Reorder tasks and project groups by dragging
View session history in year and month heatmaps
Log workouts and import completed-task history from Todoist
extras: Not yet in Obsidian's community plugin browser; the README gives BRAT and manual installation steps. States it has no telemetry and stores all data locally in the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Pomodoro timer or way to work with Todoist tasks and session history from within the app.

relations.evidence: Browse, create, select, and complete Todoist tasks without leaving Obsidian.

summary: Pomodoro timer that manages Todoist tasks inside Obsidian and records work sessions in year and month contribution heatmaps.
